function.name: time_converter
function.description: Converts the local time of user's region to the target region's local time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_timezone.description: The timezone of the user in string format. Example: 'Pacific Time (US & Canada)'

target_timezone.description: The target timezone in string format where user wants to know the local time. Example: 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)'

time.description: The local time of user's timezone in string format (24 hr format). Optional parameter. Example: '15:30:00'

message.content: 截至 2023 年底，紐約市（New York City）的估計人口約為 **860 萬**。這個數字來自美國人口普查局（U.S. Census Bureau）最新的年度估算，實際人數會因出生率、死亡率和移民流動而略有波動。

There's no mention of time conversion. So we don't need to call the function. Just answer with approximate number. According to latest estimates, New York City has about 8.5 million people. But maybe they want the population of New York state? The question says "紐約現在的人口是多少？" Could refer to New York city or state. Usually "紐約" refers to New York City. Provide approximate figure. Use up-to-date estimate: ~8.6 million as of 2023. Provide source: US Census Bureau. Also mention that it's approximate and may vary. No function needed.
